objective: Whole intact A01 aircraft in OpenRadioss: local beam frames, native structural mass plus spatial additional mass, unforced free translation, conservation and saved state audit. No outcome fitting.

units.input: m kg s Pa J kg*m^2
units.solver: mm g ms MPa N N*mm

mapping.native_shell_mass: A01 density and thickness; triangular nodal lump prediction mass/3
mapping.native_beam_mass: A01 density and area; endpoint nodal lump prediction mass/2, transverse rotational inertia may differ
mapping.additional_mass: Original A01 quadrature points, ADMAS/5 on new reference nodes; local RBE3 translation interpolation, independent structural nodes only
mapping.host_selection: Nearest 8 original structural nodes; engine points share local original engine-center plus nearest wing/pylon nodes. No global rigid body or stiffness for unresolved structure.
mapping.beam_orientation: Project global basis least parallel to beam X onto normal plane, normalize; equal Iyy/Izz makes bending invariant to remaining arbitrary twist
mapping.shell_formulation: SH3N standard C0 large-rotation Ish3n=2, Ismstr=4; LAW1 intact elastic, N=0 global elastic integration
mapping.beam_formulation: PROP/TYPE3 Ismstr=4, no damping, no released rotations, Ishear=0
mapping.known_limit: RBE3 explicit effective inertial redistribution must be checked from Starter and translation; rotation/deformation accuracy not inferred from translation. Fuel has no flow/sloshing law, engine no crush law.

sources: A01 immutable mesh, mass quadrature and material source manifest
next_objective: AIRCRAFT-A03: whole-aircraft/representative-façade assembly and bounded first-contact calculation with frozen conditions and energy accounting; retain failed or nonphysical behavior. No qualified crushing/fracture claim. Keep missing engine/structure evidence and I02I-M deferred unless a concrete blocker requires it.
